digest.component_or_area: S3 doctor and sync reconciliation healers
propositions: A shared reconcile_one function was proposed to eliminate duplicated merge and unrelated-history logic between sync.reconverge and s3_doctor._fold_heads
The ticket is marked OBSOLETE because Gerrit 1665 removed the doctor's worktree merge that was the target duplication
Sync and the doctor hold contradictory policies on unrelated histories: sync refuses to prevent grafting an orphan store while the doctor unions unconditionally
Sync cannot adopt a ref-only merge because its consumers read ticket events from tracker worktree files, while the doctor now uses merge-tree/commit-tree without touching the worktree
A behaviour-preserving shared reconcile_one cannot be implemented due to opposed failure policies, epoch-guard asymmetry, and different lock scope and head cardinality between the two healers
